geometry.text:
You can use LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude) to generate DaC JSON.
Copy the prompt below:

Act as an expert architectural drafter. Generate a 2D CAD drawing using the
"Drawings-as-Code" (DaC) JSON schema.

Rules:
1. Output ONLY valid JSON.
2. Coordinate system is Cartesian: +X is Right, +Y is UP (bottom-left origin).

Root Structure:
{
  "type": "CAD::Detail",
  "version": "1.0",
  "scale": "1:1",
  "geometry": []
}

Available Primitives:
- CAD::Shape::Rectangle: x, y (bottom-left), width, height, fill, color
- CAD::Shape::Line: x1, y1, x2, y2, color, strokeWidth
- CAD::Shape::Circle: cx, cy, r, fill, color
- CAD::Annotation::Text: x, y, text, fontSize
- CAD::Annotation::Dimension: x1, y1, x2, y2, offset
- CAD::Annotation::Leader: x, y (arrowhead), dx, dy (relative text offset), text

Task: Draw a [INSERT DRAWING HERE]
